faqs.q: What are gantries, jib cranes and davits and what do you build?
faqs.a: We build mobile and fixed steel gantries, A-frame and cantilever gantries, runway beams, jib cranes and davits to order for the load, span and height. Hoists and trolleys are supplied with them.

faqs.q: What spans and heights do mobile gantries cover?
faqs.a: Mobile gantries are designed for indoor use on a flat floor, from light units up to 5 t and more, for spans up to 10 m and heights up to 5 m and beyond. Their wheels are for positioning only, not for travelling under load.

faqs.q: What capacity can fixed gantries and runway beams be built to?
faqs.a: Fixed gantries, runway beams and supporting structures are built to any capacity, span and height, designed from your load and site data. The working load limit is set to order, not from a fixed range.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a cantilever gantry and a jib crane?
faqs.a: A cantilever gantry lands a load beyond its support, for maintenance or loading a vehicle, while jibs and davits are designed for the reach and height needed, manual or powered. See our [lifting beams](/c/lifting-beams) for below-the-hook options.

faqs.q: What materials and finish are used for gantries and jib cranes?
faqs.a: The structure is structural steel in a grade chosen by the design, with a paint system to your specification. Outdoor units can be galvanized; ask for it on the enquiry.

faqs.q: What standard are gantries and jib cranes designed to?
faqs.a: The steel structure is designed to EN 1993, load tested before dispatch, and supplied with a declaration of conformity, a test certificate and user instructions. Design calculations, material certificates, NDT records and third-party witnessed testing can be added to the order.

faqs.q: Can gantries and davits be designed for offshore use?
faqs.a: Yes, offshore designs to DNV standards are available on request, with witnessed testing and the documentation the project asks for. State the offshore requirement on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Can you supply hoists and trolleys with a gantry?
faqs.a: Yes, hoists, trolleys and chain blocks are quoted with the structure and sized to it. See our [chain blocks and manual hoists](/c/chain-blocks-manual-hoists) and [electric hoists](/c/electric-hoists).

faqs.q: How are gantries and jib cranes inspected in service?
faqs.a: Give the equipment a pre-use check before every lift and a thorough examination by a competent person at the interval your site authority sets. Its rated load, identification and test date are marked on it; read our [lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae).

faqs.q: What do I need to send to quote a gantry, jib crane or davit?
faqs.a: Send the load weight and where its centre of gravity sits, the load’s length and width, the lifting point positions, the crane hook height and any headroom limit, and the environment (indoor, outdoor, offshore, hazardous area). A drawing, a 3D model or a photo of the load is the quickest way to start.

faqs.q: How long does a made-to-order gantry take, and where is it supplied from?
faqs.a: Lead time depends on the design and the documentation and inspection the order calls for, and we confirm it with the quotation after the general arrangement drawing is agreed. Send your requirement through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where are gantries, jib cranes and davits used?
faqs.a: They are used for indoor load handling on a flat floor, for maintenance lifting, for loading a vehicle with a cantilever gantry, and wherever a runway beam or jib can serve a work area. Powered or manual jibs and davits are available.

faqs.q: What are stillages and handling racks and what do you build?
faqs.a: We build transport and lifting stillages, heavy-duty racks for chain and shackles, launch tables for glazing and cladding, lifting skids, cages and handling frames to order, designed and load tested for the item they carry.

faqs.q: What loads can stillages be built for?
faqs.a: Stillages are built from about 50 kg to 50 t and beyond, for out-of-gauge items, machinery and offsite-built components such as wall cassettes and glazed units. They can be supplied with their own lifting system.

faqs.q: What size of unit can a launch table take?
faqs.a: A launch table cantilevers out of a building opening so glazing or cladding units land on a run-out trolley and roll inside, and it is built for units up to about 2 t. Racks, skids and cages are designed for the item they carry.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a stillage and a lifting skid?
faqs.a: A stillage carries and stores an item and can be built as a lifting stillage with its own lifting system, while a skid or cage is designed around the item it carries. Both are made to order; see our [below-the-hook attachments](/c/below-the-hook-attachments).

faqs.q: What materials and finish do stillages and racks use?
faqs.a: Structural steel in a grade chosen by the design, with a paint system to your specification, and galvanizing available for outdoor use on request.

faqs.q: What standard are stillages designed to?
faqs.a: Stillages are designed to EN 13155, load tested before dispatch and supplied with a declaration of conformity, a test certificate and user instructions. ASME B30.20 / BTH-1 or DNV offshore design is available on request.

faqs.q: Can a stillage be lifted with its load?
faqs.a: Yes, when it is designed as a lifting stillage with lifting points and its own rigging. Say on the enquiry that the stillage will be lifted loaded, with the load weight and centre of gravity.

faqs.q: Can stillages be lifted with beams or spreaders?
faqs.a: Yes, a lifting stillage can be rigged with lifting beams or frames; see our [spreader frames and H-frames](/c/spreader-frames-h-frames) and [lifting beams](/c/lifting-beams).

faqs.q: How are stillages inspected in service?
faqs.a: Give the stillage a pre-use check before every lift and a thorough examination by a competent person at the interval your site authority sets. Rated load, identification and test date are marked on it; see our [lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae).

faqs.q: What do I need to send to quote a stillage or handling rack?
faqs.a: Send the load weight and where its centre of gravity sits, the load’s length and width, the lifting point positions, the crane hook height and any headroom limit, and the environment (indoor, outdoor, offshore, hazardous area). A drawing, a 3D model or a photo of the load is the quickest way to start.

faqs.q: How long does a made-to-order stillage take?
faqs.a: Lead time depends on the design and the documentation and inspection the order calls for, and we confirm it with the quotation after the general arrangement drawing is agreed. Send your requirement through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where are stillages and racks used?
faqs.a: Typical uses are transport and lifting stillages, chain, shackle and wall racks, launch tables, lifting skids, cages, handling frames, machinery trestles and transport jigs. Offshore designs to DNV standards are available on request.
